item.title: Doreia #403 took the staff in the Boule for the Gegeneis: "Hear me! Remember the stone in
item.description: Doreia #403 took the staff in the Boule for the Gegeneis: "Hear me! Remember the stone in Field of Ares. I say: let the temples get their tithe. As the old poet says, whoever takes no thought for tomorrow eats seed-corn in the winter." The assembly roared like the long waves of the Icarian sea.

item.description: Ikarmachos #185 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
